title: TOOLS-006: The generator assumes allocations, reallocations, file redirects, and path copies always succeed
description:
TOOLS-006: The generator assumes allocations, reallocations, file redirects, and path copies always succeed. `allocate()` immediately `memset()`s a possibly NULL allocation, `realloc()` results overwrite the only pointer, `freopen()` results are ignored, and `strcpy(source_file, definition_file)` can overflow `PATH_MAX`. Failures can crash the generator, read from the wrong stream, or emit partial files. Add checked allocation helpers, temporary pointers for `realloc()`, bounded path copies, and explicit `freopen()` error handling before generating output. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
